cond_0082.intro: The Quality Technician will audit, test and measure finished goods to ensure customer standards are met as well as follow our company's Good Manufacturing Practices.
cond_0082.responsibilities:
Ensure compliance with corporate and plant safety standards and with applicable laws and regulations issued by regulatory agencies.
Apply statistical tools and techniques to monitor plant performance and finished goods.
Complete laboratory testing and collect samples at established intervals.
Continually seek process improvements and make recommendations to management.
Audit compliance with GMP policies.
Performs process inspections during molding, packaging and loading.
Audit for compliance to control plan requirements including process parameters.
Perform incoming inspection of raw materials.
Complete dimensional checks and report on product.
Perform in-process inspections of manufactured product during molding, packaging and loading.
Perform cycle counts and/or inventory of finished goods as required.
Communicate quality issues and out of specifications conditions to appropriate personnel and with shift leaders.
Other duties as assigned by management.
cond_0082.requirements:
High school diploma or equivalent.
One year of related experience.
ASQ certification or equivalent preferred.
Safe work practices.
Influencing skills.
Knowledge of basic statistics.
Metrology skills including calibration.
Able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
Good computer skills.
Uses logical approach to problem solving in production and continuous improvement.
Understands the role of Quality in a manufacturing organization and a Quality Operating System.

Ensure compliance with corporate and plant safety standards and with applicable laws and regulations issued by regulatory agencies.
Apply statistical tools and techniques to monitor plant performance and finished goods.
Complete laboratory testing and collect samples at established intervals.
Continually seek process improvements and make recommendations to management.
Audit compliance with GMP policies.
Performs process inspections during molding, packaging and loading.
Audit for compliance to control plan requirements including process parameters.
Perform incoming inspection of raw materials.
Complete dimensional checks and report on product.
Perform in-process inspections of manufactured product during molding, packaging and loading.
Perform cycle counts and/or inventory of finished goods as required.
Communicate quality issues and out of specifications conditions to appropriate personnel and with shift leaders.
Other duties as assigned by management.
cond_0498.requirements:
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
A high school diploma or equivalent, or relevant practical experience in a related field.
Around one year of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and training.
ASQ certification preferred, or a willingness to obtain one.
Familiarity with safe work practices.
Ability to communicate and work with others to influence outcomes.
Working knowledge of basic statistics.
Some exposure to metrology skills including calibration.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines — this is something that can be developed on the job.
Comfort with basic computer tools.
Willingness to apply a logical approach to problem solving in production and continuous improvement settings.
A general understanding of the role of Quality in a manufacturing organization and a Quality Operating System — full familiarity can be built over time.

cond_0648.intro: The Quality Technician will work with plant teams to audit, test, and measure finished goods to help ensure customer standards are met and that Good Manufacturing Practices are followed.
cond_0648.responsibilities:
Ensure compliance with corporate and plant safety standards and with applicable laws and regulations issued by regulatory agencies.
Apply statistical tools and techniques together with plant teams to monitor plant performance and finished goods.
Complete laboratory testing and collect samples at established intervals.
Continually seek process improvements and share recommendations with management.
Coordinate audits for compliance with GMP policies.
Work alongside production staff to perform process inspections during molding, packaging, and loading.
Support compliance to control plan requirements including process parameters.
Perform incoming inspection of raw materials.
Complete dimensional checks and report on product, sharing findings with relevant personnel.
Perform in-process inspections of manufactured product during molding, packaging, and loading.
Perform cycle counts and/or inventory of finished goods as required.
Communicate quality issues and out-of-specification conditions to appropriate personnel and shift leaders.
Other duties as assigned by management.
cond_0648.requirements:
The requirements listed below are minimum requirements for the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
High school diploma or equivalent.
One year of related experience.
ASQ certification or equivalent preferred.
Safe work practices.
Influencing skills.
Knowledge of basic statistics.
Metrology skills including calibration.
Able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
Good computer skills.
Uses logical approach to problem solving in production and continuous improvement.
Understands the role of quality in a manufacturing organization and a quality operating system.
